args.goal: Test whether the existing Shopify catalogue worked example can be sold as a downloadable package through Gumroad without upfront spending. Read prior storefront evidence first and reuse any Gumroad verdict that covers this asset and current terms. Otherwise use up to three official public source pages to verify Canadian seller and payout eligibility, fees, and rules governing this exact AI-produced download. If the route is supported, prepare one offline text-encoded archive and a bilingual operator listing with AI disclosure, an explicitly provisional price, and the known free public availability of the underlying worked example. Extract the archive in a clean directory and execute the documented example and verifier. Save actual output, package hash, source citations and a copy-ready activation handoff. If a controlling condition fails or remains unknown, record that condition and the evidence that would reopen the route. Read back committed evidence and close under valid ownership with a lesson. No signup, agreement, external submission, spending or publication. Any public deployment retains host-enforced independent review. Keep preparation, activation, buyer demand, accepted sales and verified settlement separate.
